name: context-menu-47
description: PDF page thumbnails that can be rotated, duplicated, extracted, or deleted.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { CopyPlus as CopyPlusIcon, FileOutput as FileOutputIcon, RotateCcw as RotateCcwIcon, RotateCw as RotateCwIcon, Trash as TrashIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" export default function PdfPageThumbnailMenu() { const [pages, setPages] = React.useState([ { id: 1, rotation: 0 }, { id: 2, rotation: 0 }, { id: 3, rotation: 90 }, { id: 4, rotation: 0 }, ]) const rotate = (id: number, delta: number) => setPages((list) => list.map((p) => p.id === id ? { ...p, rotation: (p.rotation + delta + 360) % 360 } : p ) ) return (
{pages.map((page, index) => (
{index + 1} Page {index + 1} rotate(page.id, 90)}> Rotate clockwise rotate(page.id, -90)}> Rotate counterclockwise setPages((list) => [ ...list.slice(0, index + 1), { id: Date.now(), rotation: page.rotation }, ...list.slice(index + 1), ]) } > Duplicate page Extract as new PDF setPages((list) => list.filter((p) => p.id !== page.id)) } > Delete page ))}
) }
